resources.string: Amaphrofayili e-CPU ne-GPU ohlelweni ngalunye lokusebenza; amasethingi asebenza kuphela uma uhlelo lokusebenza lusesikrinini
Sebenzisa amasethingi e-CPU ne-GPU ohlelweni ngalunye lokusebenza
Ivala izinhlelo zokusebenza zangemuva uma kuvulwa uhlelo lokusebenza oluvela ohlwini
Amasethingi asebenza kuphela uma uhlelo lokusebenza lusesikrinini. Amafrikhwensi abuyela evamile uma uphuma ohlelweni lokusebenza. Isivikelo sokushisa sihlala sisebenza njalo.

string-array.name: game_cpu_level_summaries
string-array.item: Amafrikhwensi aphansi ukuze kube nokushisa okuncane nesikhathi eside sokudlala
Kunciphisa ikhodi eyodwa namanye amakhodi cishe ku-80 % ngezikhathi ezinde ezizinzile
Setha imikhawulo yekhodi eyodwa neyamakhodi amaningi wena

string-array.name: game_gpu_level_summaries
string-array.item: Ifrikhwensi yezithombe ephansi ukuze kube nokushisa okuncane
Kunciphisa ifrikhwensi yezithombe cishe ku-80 % ukuze kube nokushisa okuncane ezikhathini ezinde
